function.description: Gets readiness information for Security Service Insertion, including integration status, security group details, and access control information.
function.name: api_securityServiceInsertionReadiness

accessControlDetails.description: Ensure the Access Control Application is installed, Software-Defined Access is deployed (v2.2+), and virtual networks are configured.

accessControlAppPkgStatus.description: The installation status of the access control application package.

fabricSitesCount.description: The total number of fabric sites monitored.

readiness.description: Indicates the overall readiness status of the access control setup.

ise.description: Ensure ISE (Identity Services Engine) is integrated, synced, and running version 3.4 or higher.

integrationStatus.description: The current integration status of ISE.

readiness.description: Indicates the overall readiness status of the ISE system.

version.description: The current version of ISE in use.

readiness.description: Represents the overall readiness status of the system and its components.

securityGroup.description: Ensure that security groups exist; if SGTs (Security Group Tags) managed by ISE cannot be created in the Catalyst center.

readiness.description: Indicates the overall readiness status of the security groups.

securityGroupsCount.description: The total number of security groups established.

sgtManagedBy.description: The entity responsible for managing the Security Group Tags (SGTs).
